use_cases: Landing page entry point for SaaS products with visual product demonstration
Marketing hero sections showcasing software features and interfaces
Product launch pages with interactive mockup previews

ai_summary: A hero section component featuring a product mockup showcase with modern gradient styling. Designed for SaaS and software product landing pages, it combines compelling copy, call-to-action buttons, and a visual product display to drive user engagement. Includes subtle scroll animations and hover effects for enhanced interactivity.
